proof_body:
by
  intro a M c K h hc
  have hb' : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨-M, fun n => (abs_le.1 (h n)).1⟩
  have h1 : ∃ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, c < a n :=
    Filter.frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup hb'.isCoboundedUnder_le hc
  exact Filter.frequently_atTop.1 h1 K
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (M c : ℝ) (K : ℕ), (∀ n, |a n| ≤ M) → c < Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop → ∃ n, K ≤ n ∧ c < a n
